query:
SELECT s.id, s.companyName, COUNT(m.id) as currentMeetings 
FROM sponsors s 
LEFT JOIN meetings m ON m.sponsorId = s.id 
WHERE s.companyName IN ('hackajob', 'Happydance', 'Harver', 'Inploi', 'Radancy', 'Bright Apply', 'Symphony Talent')
GROUP BY s.id, s.companyName
ORDER BY s.companyName;
